sentences.en: In this experiment, dry filter mud was taken as raw material to extract sugarcane wax, and higher aliphatic alkanol products were separated from sugarcane wax.

sentences.en: This paper refers to the physiological efficiency on spring wheat seedings Produced by thirty alkanol treating seeds.

sentences.en: On account of co-metallomicelle formation, the complex with a long alkanol ligand has a stronger catalytic effect than that with a short alkanol ligand .

sentences.en: In general, this reaction will be conducted in the presence of a suitable solvent such as a lower alkanol.
